# Service health — SLO, RED metrics, and root-cause log search

Pick a service and time range below. Every panel updates for that selection. See this project's README for what each panel means and how to drill from a log row into the full distributed trace.

parameters.name: Service
parameters.query:
AppRequests
| distinct cloud_RoleName
| order by cloud_RoleName asc

parameters.name: SearchText
parameters.label: Log filter (free text, e.g. an order ID or error message fragment)

content.query:
AppRequests
| where cloud_RoleName == '{Service}'
| where timestamp {TimeRange}
| summarize ["Requests/min"] = count() / (toscalar(datetime_diff('minute', max(timestamp), min(timestamp))) + 1) by bin(timestamp, 5m)
| render timechart
content.title: Request rate

content.query:
AppRequests
| where cloud_RoleName == '{Service}'
| where timestamp {TimeRange}
| summarize Total = count(), Failed = countif(success == false) by bin(timestamp, 5m)
| extend ["Error rate %"] = round(100.0 * Failed / Total, 2)
| project timestamp, ["Error rate %"]
| render timechart
content.title: Error rate (%)

content.query:
AppRequests
| where cloud_RoleName == '{Service}'
| where timestamp {TimeRange}
| summarize P50 = percentile(duration, 50), P95 = percentile(duration, 95), P99 = percentile(duration, 99) by bin(timestamp, 5m)
| render timechart
content.title: Response time percentiles (ms)
SLO

content.json:
## Root-cause log search

Use the **Log filter** box above to search recent traces and exceptions for `{Service}` — e.g. an order ID, an item name, or an exception type. Each row below carries an `operation_Id`. Copy it and paste it into **Application Insights → Investigate → Transaction search** in the Azure Portal to see the full distributed trace for that request, including the cross-service dotnet→java call chain.

content.query:
AppExceptions
| where cloud_RoleName == '{Service}'
| where timestamp {TimeRange}
| where isempty('{SearchText}') or outerMessage has '{SearchText}' or type has '{SearchText}' or operation_Id has '{SearchText}'
| project timestamp, severityLevel = 3, kind = 'exception', operation_Id, message = strcat(type, ': ', outerMessage)
| union (
    AppTraces
    | where cloud_RoleName == '{Service}'
    | where timestamp {TimeRange}
    | where isempty('{SearchText}') or message has '{SearchText}' or operation_Id has '{SearchText}'
    | project timestamp, severityLevel, kind = 'trace', operation_Id, message
)
| order by timestamp desc
| take 200
content.title: Matching traces and exceptions
content.noDataMessage: No traces or exceptions match this filter in the selected time range.
